about: Daniel tells how Daniel and his friends stayed faithful to God in Babylon.

pages.title: Healthy Food
pages.text: Daniel and his friends were taken to Babylon to serve the king. They were offered the king's rich food, but Daniel asked, "Can we have vegetables and water instead?" After ten days, they were healthier than everyone else!
pages.lesson: Follow God, even far from home.

pages.title: The Fiery Furnace
pages.scene: Three friends and an angel walking in the fire
pages.text: The king made a huge gold statue and said, "Everyone must bow down!" But Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego would not. They were thrown into a fire. The king looked and saw four men walking in the fire! God kept them safe.
pages.lesson: Stand up for God, and He will be with you.

pages.title: The Writing on the Wall
pages.scene: A hand writing on the palace wall
pages.text: King Belshazzar had a big party and used God's holy cups. Suddenly, a hand wrote on the wall! No one could read it. Daniel told the king what it meant: "God says your kingdom is over." That night the kingdom ended.

pages.title: Daniel and the Lions
pages.scene: Daniel with the lions and an angel
pages.text: A new law said, "Pray only to the king." But Daniel kept praying to God by his window. He was thrown into a den of lions! In the morning the king ran to the den. Daniel said, "God sent His angel to shut the lions' mouths!"
pages.lesson: Keep praying, and trust God to keep you safe.
